newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Pioneer Hi-Bred buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pioneer Hi-Bred buy repeated.

text.p: Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said on Monday she reiterated her buy rating on Pioneer Hi-Bred International Inc, which earlier today announced a farm management information alliance.
-- Pioneer formed the alliance with Case Corp and Dow Chemical Co's DowElanco unit.

-- "The key here is that this is the first time companies of this magnitude have agreed to put all the puzzle pieces together to provide an integrated source of information for their common constituents," Wittenburg said in a report.

-- In the short-term, the alliance is not expected to change earnings estimates for Pioneer, she added. "...But we do believe this is the start of a major trend within the industry to create more value-added products and services from seed-to-harvest."
-- Pioneer shares were off 5/8 at 70-5/8. Case shares were up 1/4 at 59-7/8. Dow shares gained 5/8 at 85.
